text: Hearth City's public service station is complete. A fleet of service vehicles and two administrative staff can carry out commissions.
Lakeside City's public service station is complete. A fleet of service vehicles and two administrative staff can carry out commissions.
Mine Ridge City's public service station is complete. A fleet of service vehicles and two administrative staff can carry out commissions.
Hearth City now gives priority to shared affairs. Expenditure for this period is not reset, and the allowance does not add to stockpiles.
The joint project was not approved: Hearth City has not yet authorized public services. Existing supply and responsibility records are retained. Contributions or priorities can be adjusted.
The cities approved Hearth City's housing district, to be funded locally. Construction will begin only after supplies arrive and are installed. No residents are added.
Hearth City's joint housing project is complete. Actual beds added: {变量1}. Residents must arrive through births or relocation, and upkeep remains a local expense.

Old Town paid for handover teaching materials, and two current clerks registered their duties. This city paid separately for building materials to prepare a succession workshop. Old Town's population and public stores remain on their original ledgers. Idle workers take turns resting when reserves are sufficient.
Hearth City changed its admission jobs to cooperative toolmaking. Actual inputs and products are recorded in the local public stores.
Old Town opened a handover course for two young clerks. Both are temporarily away from their regular posts. Teaching materials have been paid for.
Hearth City's succession workshop is complete. Actual jobs added: {变量1}. Current cooperative staff are registered. Future replacements require paid training.
Hearth City updated its job commission: local training and succession.

The registered cities agreed to take turns managing operations. Maintenance and ongoing expenses are set aside first, then courses, hiring, and supplies continue as conditions allow. Each locality still pays its own costs.

The localities agreed on standard processing · cooperative supply, with each paying its own costs. The institution schedules existing workshops according to reserves. New projects require a separate vote, and signed supply commitments are not canceled.
Hearth City's iron reserves have recovered. Commissioned workshops have resumed standard processing.
